correctness.rationale: Riemann–Hurwitz computes genus four; valuation checks produce four regular differential eigenforms. Exact polynomial extraction of the 11-Cartier operator gives diagonal coefficients (4A,-5B,-5t^4B,4t^2A). An independent standard-library polynomial verifier checks all Cartier-selected coefficients. Inseparable roots cannot occur because each irreducible quadratic is separable, and all roots are admissible. Semilinear stable rank is 2 on their roots and 4 elsewhere, with a-number 4 minus instantaneous rank.

value.rationale: The balanced four-branch inertia (1,2,3,4) defines a natural genus-four cyclic-cover Hurwitz family distinct from previously treated repeated-inertia cases. The exact two-factor Cartier structure forces only ranks 2 or 4, detects the entire nonordinary divisor as four reduced geometric points and gives their minimal field of definition. This resolves a motivated complete arithmetic stratum rather than an arbitrary parameter slice or tabulated example.
